parsed_design.design_rationale: Symmetric double-parallelogram with two floating intermediate stages and central output. Four long thin flexures in series-parallel on each side give low transverse stiffness for >3mm stroke at 5N while paired top/bottom beams cancel rotation and axial chord-shortening is distributed across two stages, keeping parasitic dx and theta low. 0.7mm thickness satisfies min feature and keeps stress below 25MPa in polypropylene.
